name: CHILDREN'S HEART CENTER
address: 2041 NE WILLIAMSON CT STE A, BEND, OR 97701

fr.recommendations:
• Mark the driveway entrance with reflective address numbers visible from the road in both directions.
• Post the address visibly at the main entry point to help responding units confirm the correct property.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and both detached structures so responders can move between buildings quickly.
• Trim vegetation along the access drive to maintain clearance for emergency vehicles on both sides and overhead.
• Mark secondary access points so responding units can quickly identify all entry options without searching the perimeter.
• Keep gates at secondary access points unlocked or secured with a method that allows rapid entry by responders.
• Clear a direct walking path to the rear of the property so responders are not blocked when front access is unavailable.
• Cut back dense vegetation along the rear and sides of the property to allow responders to move around all structures on foot.
• Identify a flat, open area near the access drive that responding units can use to stage vehicles without blocking the driveway.
• Mark the locations of both detached structures on any posted property diagram so arriving units know the layout before approaching.
• Thin vegetation between the detached structures and the main residence to keep a visible line of sight between buildings.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Remove woody debris piles visible near the structure.
• Thin the tree cluster to create open space between individual trees and the structure.
• Trim shrubs growing directly next to or touching the structure.
• Cut grass growing close to the structure down to a short height.
• Separate scattered shrubs from the structure by clearing a wider open area between them and the building.
• Remove dead branches and woody material from beneath scattered trees near the structure.
• Keep the area under scattered trees clear of grass and shrub growth.
• Move any woody debris away from the base of the structure and any attached or nearby outbuildings.
• Trim low-hanging branches on scattered trees close to the structure.
• Keep both access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation.
